footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 6.8% to $342M in 2025. Gross margin was 79.2%, versus 86.4% a year earlier, and the company had an operating loss of $841K, versus operating income of $27.9M.
Net income fell 94.8% to $3.6M, or $0.12 per share. Operating cash flow was $95.3M and free cash flow $75.0M, versus $115M; Ibotta returned $233M through buybacks.
sources: Ibotta, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
